notes.title: Gameplay Teaser
notes.notes:
Clearance Level 4 Required

[BEGIN TRANSMISSION]

This is Subtle Bravado Studios and CRITICAL REFLEX. Containment of SCP-▉▉▉▉ has failed. Your primary goal is asset recontainment with minimal collateral. Do not engage in any contact with the entity unless equipped with proper cognitohazard filtration equipment.  

[previewyoutube=Uf-dX9Q8uAo;full][/previewyoutube]

You are hereby briefed on Operation ███. Remember: "Secure. Contain. Protect." 

[END TRANSMISSION]

Hold your loved ones tight and join Critical Reflex Discord and Publisher Page.

This is far from over.

notes.title: OFFICIAL MISSION STATEMENT
notes.notes:
Hello, future operatives,

[previewyoutube=9nuLBiTmI2U;full][/previewyoutube]

Together with[b] CRITICAL REFLEX[/b], [b]Subtle Bravado Studios[/b] now operates outside normal jurisdiction to contain anomalous objects, entities and phenomena. We exist to support normalcy by maintaining anomalies requiring [b]Special Containment Procedures[/b], commonly shortened to as "SCPs". Under our watch civilians can [b]sleep without fear[/b], [b]live without doubt[/b] and [b]exist without questioning customary beliefs[/b].

Welcome to [b]the Foundation[/b], and good luck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41489225/c0072b3ae837eefb41825ba86398b7a5994e5c62.png[/img]

[h3][b]That which is hidden will be brought to light.[/b][/h3] [b]Infiltrate the labs[/b] of nefarious Valravn research facilities as Leena Sorjova, an elite GOC combat operative. Amalgamate forces with Field Agent Walker and [b]uncover hundreds of fateful secrets and classified documents[/b]. When war is declared, [b]truth is the first casualty[/b].

[h3][b]Eat or be eaten.[/b][/h3] Face off against an army of the [b]specialized mercenaries[/b] and [b]weaponized anomalies[/b]. Challenge [b]mad gods[/b] and [b]murderous AI[/b]. Outwit your foes or become the prey. [b]Death is breathing down your back[/b] in the silence of narrow corridors of Valravn corporation.

[h3][b]Victory is earned, not given.[/b][/h3] Blur the line between [b]action[/b] and [b]stealth[/b]. Pay close attention to enemy callouts and [b]plan your attacks[/b] before it’s too late. Keep the track of your munition against the [b]foes that bend the borders of reality[/b]. Adapt and shape your destiny. [b]Nothing is impossible[/b] here.

[b]Hold your loved ones tight[/b] and join Critical Reflex Discord and Publisher Page.
